Name: Load Balancer Port
Description: Master server / load balancer. This is the address:port players point their client at (lb_listenTo).

Name: Shard Port
Description: Shard (session/hangar) service. Clients are redirected here by the load balancer (shard_listenTo).

Name: Battle Server Ports
Description: Base port and range for DedicatedServer.exe battle instances spawned per match (net_gamePort). One port per concurrent battle.

Name: Hub Port
Description: Hub, which the services connect to (hub_listenTo, and the node address in cloud.xml). Internal: do not forward or open it to players. Each instance needs its own, so several servers can run on one host.

Name: Hub Status Port
Description: Hub's JSONP status listener (jsonp_listenPort). Internal: do not forward or open it to players. Each instance needs its own, so several servers can run on one host.

Name: MongoDB Port
Description: The bundled MongoDB (mongod --port, db_mongoHosts). Bound to 127.0.0.1. Unused with an external MongoDB. Internal: do not forward or open it to players. Each instance needs its own, so several servers can run on one host.
